The data clearly shows:
- F2_Z01's occupied cooling setpoint stayed at 24.0 until 2018-06-16, then permanently dropped to 23.0 for the rest of the year (occupied hours unchanged — still 26.7 setpoint during unoccupied hours).
- The zone's actual temperature dropped correspondingly (~0.9 °C).
- This is a persistent ~1 °C lower setpoint on F2_Z01 only — a setpoint change, not a change in the occupied time windows.

This pattern (setpoint value changed and held, occupied schedule otherwise unchanged, other core zones' setpoints unchanged) matches "local override or controller offset".
